component.name: SecondScene
component.script:
sub init() m.top.id = "scene2" m.label = m.top.findNode("label") m.timer = m.top.createChild("Timer") m.timer.repeat = true m.timer.duration = 0.1 m.timer.observeField("fire", "onFire") m.timer.control = "start" m.top.setFocus(true) end sub
sub onFire() m.top.ticks = m.top.ticks + 1 m.label.text = "Scene 2 ticks=" + m.top.ticks.toStr() + " lastKey=" + m.top.lastKey end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean if press then m.top.lastKey = key return false end function
